{"type":"thought","data":"The book command failed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" due to an argument "}
{"type":"thought","data":"error."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nResearch on the Hull"}
{"type":"thought","data":" City vs Brentford match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is complete. Bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw odds range from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 3.90 to 4.11, implying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 24% to 25%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.235 is slightly below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this fair estimate."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBet365 and 1xBet imply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 24% to 25% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for a draw. Several "}
{"type":"thought","data":"prediction models also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favor a draw, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"SportSignals at 27.7%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Squawka at 26-27%, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and OddAlerts at 28%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Football Whispers and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sports Mole both predict"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 1-1 result."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.235 price is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" cheap versus both bookmakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and models. I am calculating"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the payout: a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet buys roughly 426"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shares at that price,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" each paying 1 token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the draw occurs."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favor the draw. A 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet on Yes yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +10 profit if the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability is 26%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but only about +4 if"}
{"type":"thought","data":" it is 24.5%. Betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No at 0.765 would lose"}
{"type":"thought","data":" money across all tested"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probabilities."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe 0.235 price is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" nearly fair against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmakers. The real"}
{"type":"thought","data":" question is whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value or simply pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome with the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning. No carries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 76.5% chance, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes offers only a slight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge if models are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"correct."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am weighing whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value or simply pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the most probable outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":" My record shows I have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" been strong at backing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorites, but I lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on two draws and several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other underdogs. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw is only about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"24% likely, so No is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the safer choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIn this competition,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" every agent places "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a bet. The goal is to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outperform the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, not merely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to maximize expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value in isolation."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A correct No bet returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 30 tokens, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"while a correct Yes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet returns about 325"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. Because the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout scales with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the probability of winning,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw carries a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"far larger upside than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the outcome with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of resolving in favor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of the bet, not expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value. The No side "}
{"type":"thought","data":"carries a 76.5% chance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning, making "}
{"type":"thought","data":"it the safer choice."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThis is a single-round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition. If every"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agent picks No,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I would tie with them."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A correct Yes bet would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outscore them by roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 325 to 31, but a wrong"}
{"type":"thought","data":" one would lose badly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" my own score relative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to the other agents."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe scoreboard likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" reflects cumulative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L across all rounds."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If this is a single-round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition, picking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No wins the round roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 76% of the time, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a correct Yes bet would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" dominate by a wide "}
{"type":"thought","data":"margin."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Dimers model's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 23.8% draw rate matches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price almost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exactly, confirming"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the odds are well calibrated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with no clear edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sports Mole, Football"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Whispers, and Squawka"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all explicitly predict"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 1-1 result."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBrentford are the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stronger side with 13"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goals and bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds near 56% to win."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Hull have been poor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on the road, drawn "}
{"type":"thought","data":"all three away games"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this season and lost"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their last match. Their"}
{"type":"thought","data":" attack has struggled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with only eight goals"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in seven games. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" two teams are separated"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by just one point in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the league table."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMost models still "}
{"type":"thought","data":"place the non-draw outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at roughly 72% to 76%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The confidence parameter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" should be set near "}
{"type":"thought","data":"0.75, reflecting about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 75% probability for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe kickoff and market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" close both occur at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 14:00 UTC. I will check"}
{"type":"thought","data":" live odds and any late"}
{"type":"thought","data":" team news before placing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am checking whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw price has "}
{"type":"thought","data":"moved since my last "}
{"type":"thought","data":"review. I also reviewed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" my historical record:"}
{"type":"thought","data":" my two draw losses "}
{"type":"thought","data":"cost 100 tokens each,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while every other correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No bet returned between"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 17 and 44 tokens. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms that backing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No on draw markets "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is profitable when the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payout is high enough."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will set confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.74, slightly below"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.765. A 27% true draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability would give"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes a modest positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 15 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe draw is priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at roughly 25.5% based"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on current team news"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and form. Brentford"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are still the clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorites to win the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match itself. I will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" place the bet on No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with confidence 0.74."}

\n\n[Brentford](/football/brentford/) \n\n# Preview: Hull City vs Brentford - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Ben Sully](/team/ben-sully/) | 23 Oct 2026 18:06, Last updated: 24 Oct 2026 01:16 \n\n![Hull City vs Brentford - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/a1Pq9m-k9mj3EiBU1vXLWVzhzv0=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fjakirovic-5-6adb81975cd51648533946.png) \n\n© Imago / IPS\n\n[Hull City](/football/hull-city/ \"Hull City\") will look to maintain their unbeaten home record in Sunday's Premier League clash against a [Brentford](/football/brentford/ \"Brentford\") side yet to lose on their travels this term. \n\nThe Bees head into the weekend in sixth spot in the **[Premier League table](/football/premier-league/table.html)**, while the Tigers are one point worse off in ninth position. \n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nHull made an impressive start to their first Premier League campaign in 10 years, taking eight points from a possible 12 to occupy a top-four spot after the opening four matchdays.\n\nHowever, [Sergej Jakirovic](/people/sergej-jakirovic/ \"Sergej Jakirovic\")'s side have experienced something of a reality check in recent times, having mustered just one point from their last three outings.\n\nAfter falling to their first league defeat of the season away to Newcastle United, the Tigers played out a 2-2 draw at home to Everton, before they fell to a 1-0 defeat against Fulham at Craven Cottage last Saturday.\n\nJakirovic admitted after the game that \"it was men against boys\", a comment that was backed up by the fact Hull failed to register a single shot on target and registered just 139 passes, their lowest Premier League pass tally since mustering 134 in a 1-0 defeat to Blackburn Rovers in February 2010.\n\nWhile they are now winless in five Premier League games, Hull are still sitting in the top half of the table and will be looking forward to returning to the MKM Stadium, where they are yet to lose this season after recording one win and two draws in their first three home games.\n\nThe Tigers claimed clean sheets in two of those three home outings, and they will need all that defensive resilience when they take on a Brentford side that are the league's fourth-highest scorers with 13 goals.\n\nWhile Sunday's fixture may be the first top-flight meeting between the two sides, Hull have won four of their last five competitive home games against Brentford, although they slumped to a heavy 5-1 defeat in their most recent encounter at the MKM Stadium in February 2020. \n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/XX8Qlsy-CpSqBskiXH3GmQYJ7kM=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fthiago-lewis-potter-6adb82a4479fa327821481.png)\n\n© Imago / Sportimage\n\nBrentford, meanwhile, are sitting in sixth spot and three points adrift of the top four after winning two, drawing four and losing one of their first seven matches.\n\nKeith Andrews's side suffered their first loss of the season in last Saturday's home clash with Liverpool, despite taking a 44th-minute lead through [Keane Lewis-Potter](/people/keane-lewis-potter/ \"Keane Lewis-Potter\").\n\nHowever, the complexion of the contest changed dramatically when [Yehor Yarmolyuk](/people/yehor-yarmolyuk/ \"Yehor Yarmolyuk\") was sent off for violent conduct in first-half stoppage time, handing Liverpool a numerical advantage that helped them turn the game in their favour with goals from Victor Munoz and Alexander Isak.\n\nThe loss was compounded by [Vitaly Janelt](/people/vitaly-janelt/ \"Vitaly Janelt\")'s late red card, leaving Andrews with some crucial selection decisions to make ahead of the club's first meeting with Hull in six years, with the visitors looking to extend their unbeaten head-to-head run to four matches after previously recording a pair of 5-1 wins on either side of a 1-1 draw.\n\nThe Bees head into the weekend as one of four Premier League teams yet to lose on the road this season, although they are also still searching for their first away league win after playing out draws against Leeds United, Bournemouth and Aston Villa. \n\nIn fact, Brentford have gone eight consecutive top-flight away games since enjoying a run of three consecutive road wins in February.\n\nThe visitors will at least fancy their chances of striking first in Sunday's fixture, having netted the opening goal in all seven of their seven Premier League outings this season. \n\nHull City Premier League form:\n\n* Imago / Action Plus\n\nHull's considerable injury list features Jack Butland, Charlie Hughes, Matt Targett, Eliot Matazo, Darko Gyabi and Ilyas Ansah. \n\nDefender Nobel Mendy is set to return to team training on Monday, with the aim of him returning to the squad for the home clash against Ipswich Town on October 31.\n\nMohamed-Ali Cho and Lucas Gourna-Douath, who have both missed the last two games, are in contention to make Sunday's squad after recently making their welcome return to training. \n\nIn more positive news, Robinio Vaz has seemingly avoided any lasting damage from the tackle that saw Fulham's Ryan Sessegnon sent off in the closing stages of last Saturday's contest. \n\nAs for the Bees, they remain without the services of Joshua Dasilva, Kaye Furo and Antoni Milambo due to injury. \n\nDefender Jannik Schuster is back in training after missing the defeat to Liverpool due to a combination of illness and a knock. \n\nAndrews will be forced to completely change his central midfield pairing, with Yarmolyuk and Janelt set to serve three-match and one-game bans, respectively.\n\nMathias Jensen will drop back from the number 10 spot to operate alongside Mamadou Sangare in the engine room, while Mikkel Damsgaard and Kevin Schade are set to come into the side to feature in the attacking trio behind Igor Thiago. \n\n**Hull City possible starting lineup:**\n\nTzolakis; Coyle, Ajayi, Egan, Herrington, Giles; Belloumi, Iroegbunam, Slater, Thomas; McBurnie\n\n**Brentford possible starting lineup:**\n\nKelleher; Kayode, Schuster, Ajer, Lewis-Potter; Jensen, Sangare; Anthony, Damsgaard, Schade; Thiago\n\n* * Everton, before they fell to a 1-0 defeat against Fulham at Craven Cottage last Saturday.\n\nJakirovic admitted after the game that \"it was men against boys\", a comment that was backed up by the fact Hull failed to register a single shot on target and registered just 139 passes, their lowest Premier League pass tally since mustering 134 in a 1-0 defeat to Blackburn Rovers in February 2010.\n\nWhile they are now winless in five Premier League games, Hull are still sitting in the top half of the table and will be looking forward to returning to the MKM Stadium, where they are yet to lose this season after recording one win and two draws in their first three home games.\n\nThe Tigers claimed clean sheets in two of those three home outings, and they will need all that defensive resilience when they take on a Brentford side that are the league's fourth-highest scorers with 13 goals.\n\nWhile Sunday's fixture may be the first top-flight meeting between the two sides, Hull have won four of their last five competitive home games against Brentford, although they slumped to a heavy 5-1 defeat in their most recent encounter at the MKM Stadium in February 2020. \n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/XX8Qlsy-CpSqBskiXH3GmQYJ7kM=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fthiago-lewis-potter-6adb82a4479fa327821481.png)\n\n© Imago / Sportimage\n\nBrentford, meanwhile, are sitting in sixth spot and three points adrift of the top four after winning two, drawing four and losing one of their first seven matches.\n\nKeith Andrews's side suffered their first loss of the season in last Saturday's home clash with Liverpool, despite taking a 44th-minute lead through [Keane Lewis-Potter](/people/keane-lewis-potter/ \"Keane Lewis-Potter\").\n\nHowever, the complexion of the contest changed dramatically when [Yehor Yarmolyuk](/people/yehor-yarmolyuk/ \"Yehor Yarmolyuk\") was sent off for violent conduct in first-half stoppage time, handing Liverpool a numerical advantage that helped them turn the game in their favour with goals from Victor Munoz and Alexander Isak.\n\nThe loss was compounded by [Vitaly Janelt](/people/vitaly-janelt/ \"Vitaly Janelt\")'s late red card, leaving Andrews with some crucial selection decisions to make ahead of the club's first meeting with Hull in six years, with the visitors looking to extend their unbeaten head-to-head run to four matches after previously recording a pair of 5-1 wins on either side of a 1-1 draw.\n\nThe Bees head into the weekend as one of four Premier League teams yet to lose on the road this season, although they are also still searching for their first away league win after playing out draws against Leeds United, Bournemouth and Aston Villa. \n\nIn fact, Brentford have gone eight consecutive top-flight away games since enjoying a run of three consecutive road wins in February.\n\nThe visitors will at least fancy their chances of striking first in Sunday's fixture, having netted the opening goal in all seven of their seven Premier League outings this season. \n\nHull City Premier League form:\n\n* Imago / Action Plus\n\nHull's considerable injury list features Jack Butland, Charlie Hughes, Matt Targett, Eliot Matazo, Darko Gyabi and Ilyas Ansah. \n\nDefender Nobel Mendy is set to return to team training on Monday, with the aim of him returning to the squad for the home clash against Ipswich Town on October 31.\n\nMohamed-Ali Cho and Lucas Gourna-Douath, who have both missed the last two games, are in contention to make Sunday's squad after recently making their welcome return to training. \n\nIn more positive news, Robinio Vaz has seemingly avoided any lasting damage from the tackle that saw Fulham's Ryan Sessegnon sent off in the closing stages of last Saturday's contest. \n\nAs for the Bees, they remain without the services of Joshua Dasilva, Kaye Furo and Antoni Milambo due to injury. \n\nDefender Jannik Schuster is back in training after missing the defeat to Liverpool due to a combination of illness and a knock. \n\nAndrews will be forced to completely change his central midfield pairing, with Yarmolyuk and Janelt set to serve three-match and one-game bans, respectively.\n\nMathias Jensen will drop back from the number 10 spot to operate alongside Mamadou Sangare in the engine room, while Mikkel Damsgaard and Kevin Schade are set to come into the side to feature in the attacking trio behind Igor Thiago. \n\n**Hull City possible starting lineup:**\n\nTzolakis;
